text:
ops-bot: PAGERDUTY — P1 ALERT: Elevated 502/504 rate on API gateway for /v1/generate. Started 2026-06-14 14:12 UTC. Current 502 rate ~10% across eu-west frontends. Pager: sre-oncall. Incident channel created: <https://slack.redwood/archives/INC-1839990000>
neha: I'm on it, joining channel. grabbing ingress + envoy logs now.
carl: seeing same. edge proxies in eu-west returning 502s, cluster mux shows increased fanout to model-pool-3 and a lot of upstream resets.
neha: quick k8s check — ingress pods look Running, cpu flat. running:
```
kubectl get pods -n ingress -o wide | grep ingress-eu-west
```
no OOMs.
lina: telemetry: spike scoped to /v1/generate only, health routes ok. rollout window earlier at 12:45 UTC touched model-pool-3 (small canary). correlation looks strong.
carl: envoy logs show "upstream response timeout" and connection reset by peer. retries are causing additional fanout, exacerbating load.
oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) enable fast-circuit on /v1/generate at edge 2) shift 20% traffic to eu-north standby 3) block prefetch/batching at edge header. I'll run steps in that order.
neha: executing runbook step 2 -> apply header to stop edge prefetching. Pushing header injection via ingress config:
```
- add: x-rr-disable-prefetch: "1"
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: ingress config change applied -> config-id=6132, canary on ingress-eu-west-1.
katie: customer-impact snapshot: ~3% of paid requests failing overall; top affected customers: AcmeCorp, SparkNotes (small spike in support tickets). I alerted CS and support ops.
jamie: if errors don't drop in 5m we should rollback the 12:45 model rollout. carl, can you prepare rollback pr?
carl: rollback PR queued and ready (PR#472); holding until shift/circuits show effect for 2m.
oncall-sre: starting traffic shift: route /v1/generate -> 20% to eu-north standby via routing policy. monitoring now.
neha: observing metrics: 60s after header + shift, 502 rate down from 10% -> 2.1%.
carl: continuing to watch envoy upstream latencies, no new OOMs in model pool. looks like retries were main multiplier.
neha: 5m after actions: errors at 0.8%. keeping fast-circuit open and header enforced for 10m. will not rollback yet.
katie: :white_check_mark: CS notified customers A/B via status page update and support triage.
oncall-sre: preparing handoff notes for night oncall (15:00 UTC): actions taken, PR#472 rollback ready, config-id 6132 active, traffic-shift policy id ts-1839, monitor dashboards: gateway-5xx, envoy-upstream-reset, model-pool-queue-depth. Leaving post-incident checklist for follow-up.
jamie: neha to own postmortem. schedule post-incident sync + action item tracking in ops-runbook. :thumbsup:
neha: I will own the postmortem and follow-ups. saving logs & traces to incident folder and will run deeper root-cause analysis on model-pool scaling + retry logic.
oncall-sre: incident status -> mitigated. continuing watch for 30m, then clear. thanks all for quick responses.
